notes: Archive payloads move generated artifacts out of the hot working set and remain ignored by Git.
Small control caches such as industry/style maps, rolling_pools, liquidity_buckets and states stay hot unless manually reviewed.
When a rule defines max_hot_size_mb, keep_recent_count and protect_globs stay hard-protected while recent_days becomes a soft hot-set preference.

rules.name: output_runs
rules.description: Archive completed experiment directories from daily_research/output after they leave the hot working set.

rules.name: output_root_files
rules.description: Archive one-off comparison tables, notes and logs from the output root once they age out.

rules.name: deep_alpha_corpus_cache
